items.name: Salad kit without croutons, olives, cheese, beans, smoked salmon and extra balsamic dressing
items.note: Reported consumed on October 21 Eastern: whole salad kit except croutons, whole olive can, whole 4 oz cheese package, half bean can, half smoked salmon package, plus 2 oz dressing. Meal estimate includes approximately 50 kcal removed for unweighed croutons. Additional dressing assumed 2 fluid oz (4 tbsp), in addition to kit dressing. Fiber approximately 10 g. No breakfast reported; day incomplete.
